Save - On "Save" user is given the feedback for the saved line item, along with the option to "Add another" line item or "Close" the dialog.

Navigation actions -
Back - go to previous screen in the workflow
Continue - go to next screen in the workflow
Close - close project data entry and return to Project home screen

item.title: [CRPDB-201] FT - Data maintenance - Code table

description.p: The application administrator needs to be able to maintain code values that are used for the lists throughout the application, so that the users have updated and relevant values to choose from for their data entry.
Wireframe- Code Tables

ul.li: Permissions - User needs a role with code write permission to add/update.

Filters -
Code value set-
this is a single select mandatory filter, with search.
this shows the list of various drop down values that the admin may need to see/update. For example - Nearest Town, RC etc. (all list values)
Show the following on mouse over - "Select the Code set to view/update. For e.g. Capital Index, Nearest Town, RC etc."
Default selection to Accomplishments
Code Value/Code Name filter
Text input search field to perform search within both Code Values and Code Name
Provide mouse over text - "Looks for search text in codes, such as 55711, as well as description text, such as HQ"
Status filter
Show Active and/or inactive values
By default select Active

User Actions - These options area only applicable for the code set selected
Add New - Opens the add/edit dialog to add new Code value/Description/Order number - at least Code Value or Code Name has to be provided to save the record, if not provide an error at the top of the dialog - "At least Code Value or Code Name has to be provided"
Allow the user to Cancel out if no values are added, if some value is provided ask confirmation regarding the unsaved data.
Uniqueness - +Within each code set + Code Value-Should be unique (except when Code Value is NULL), as well as Code value-Code Description combination should be unique, also applies when editing these values. uniqueness should be checked without case sensitivity i.e. 'ABC', 'Abc, and 'abc' are all same.
Provide help text -
Code Value - "Representative values for descriptive fields (e.g. C for Construct). For records with no such values this field can be left empty, and just Code Name can be provide, (e.g. names of towns)".
Code Name - "Description for Code Value (e.g. Construct), or independent look up value where no code value is applicable (e.g. Town names - Abbotsford)

Data Table -
Code value - returns the Code for the drop down. For example - 55711 (for 55711 - HQ RC)
Code Description - returns the Name or the description of the code. For example HQ RC (for 55711 - HQ RC)
Order Number - shows the order in which these values would appear in a list.
Data table actions
the values can be sorted by Code value or Code description field on the screen
Edit - opens the dialog to edit the code value/description/order number
Allow the user to Cancel out if no values are updated, if some value is changed ask confirmation regarding the unsaved data at cancel.
To submit/save - at least Code Value or Code Name has to be provided, if not - provide an error at the top of the dialog - "At least Code Value or Code Description has to be provided"
Disable/Enable/Delete code value
For code values that are active and have been used only show the disable icon and when clicked on ask user to confirm - "This value will be disable. Are you sure?" - With Disable and Cancel options. Show mouseover text - "Disable record"
For code values that are active and have NOT been used only show the delete (trash can) icon and when clicked on ask user to confirm - "This value will be deleted. Are you sure?" - With Delete and Cancel options. Show mouseover text - "Delete record"
For code values that are Inactive the greyed out disable icon and when clicked on ask user to confirm - "This value will be enabled. Are you sure?" - With Enable and Cancel options. Show mouseover text - "Enable record"
